macros.name: array
macros.doc: Store or get the content of the array element specified by the index.

macros.name: cachedata
macros.doc: Macro where the content is stored after a \check request.

macros.name: clrarray
macros.doc: Clear the content of the array element specified.

macros.name: dataheight
macros.doc: Counter containing the number of elements in the first dimension, if arrays are bi-dimensional.

macros.name: readarray
macros.doc: Store consecutive values in an array, starting from the indice one.
